description: The structured change at one site between two dates (t0, t1): per class (water, ice, canopy, pad, stockpile) the area changed, what optical and radar each saw, and a confidence. Read `height_class` first: only repeat_surface supports a volume change. Slow (about 15–60 s): start=true answers at once with a job_id for job_status. Agent keys only. Metered: see CHARGING in the server instructions; quote first with `billing_quote`.

entity_type.description: Entity kind: deposit | infrastructure | company | project. With id; or pass lat + lng.

max_cloud.description: Maximum cloud cover of a scene, 0-100 percent. Default 40.

radius_m.description: Footprint radius in metres, 50-2500, overriding the site's held footprint (else a 500 m circle).

same_season.description: For spans of 300+ days, take the t0 frame at t1's day of year. Default true.

start.description: true: answer at once with a job_id (the same reservation, settled when the measurement is done)

t0.description: The earlier date, YYYY-MM-DD, on or after 1984-03-16. Required.

t1.description: The later date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today.

name: entity_change
